instruction: Use Pymatgen to download the perovskite SrTiO3 structure (mp-5229) from Materials Project. Apply SpacegroupAnalyzer to perform symmetry analysis and extract the conventional standard structure to ensure lattice orthogonality. Export the processed structure as a CIF file and save it to the desktop. Then open the CIF file in VESTA, switch the display style to 'Ball and Stick' model, and save the file to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\SrTiO3_structure.vesta'.
